preconditions.description: n is the number of problems (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and k is the number of teams (1 ≤ k ≤ 4).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == k for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines contains exactly k integers (0 or 1), representing whether each team knows the problem.

preconditions.expression: all(all(bit in {0, 1} for bit in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each bit in the input is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().upper() == 'YES' if any(all(sum(team_knows_problem[problem_idx] for problem_idx in selected_problems) <= len(selected_problems) // 2 for team_knows_problem in zip(*[line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])) for selected_problems in non_empty_subsets(range(n))) else stdout.strip().upper() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists a non-empty subset of problems such that for every team, the number of problems they know in the subset is at most half the size of the subset. Otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
